Card Q&A.q: If I activate EX5-064 [Koh & Sayo]'s [On Play] [Main] effect and place the top card of this card as the bottom digivolution card, then digivolve this card into a Digimon card, can I activate this card's inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When effects place this Digimon's top stacked card as its bottom digivolution card, ＜Draw 1＞ and trash 1 card in your hand.
